 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Los Angeles Lakers have the joint-best record in the NBA this season, but Ramona Shelburne believes they have had it easy. 
 The Lakers are 12-2 to start the season, the best start in the NBA along with the San Antonio Spurs. Luka Doncic has been on another level this season.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement However, much has been made about their start to the season, with some claiming that the teams they've faced along the way have been easier opponents.
 Ramona Shelburne faces massive NBA fan backlash for suggesting LA Lakers have had an easy start
 Speaking on NBA Today on ESPN, Ramona Shelburne made an offhand remark when discussing the Los Angeles Lakers' 12-2 start to the season.
 She suggested that the Lakers' strong performances early on have been largely due to them facing weaker teams to open their campaign.
 "It's easy to find your way when you're playing one of the easiest schedules in the league," Shelburne said on NBA Today. "And then, they have an extremely easy schedule over the next three or four games here. They've got two games against Utah, two games against Sacramento coming up, and they have the Hornets here. Then, the day after Thanksgiving, at San Antonio. If they do what they have been doing, we are looking at a team that could be 16-2 heading into that match-up in San Antonio. And that is the real measuring stick.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "As Tim said, they've been winning games against bad teams, but one of the things that is concerning for the Lakers is that they have one of the worst net ratings in the fourth quarter. In other words, they're building leads but giving them up and blowing them. Then you have Luka having to come back into games, and you can get away with that against bad teams, but you certainly can't against a good one.
 Understandably, many fans were outraged by Shelburne's claims, suggesting that she was ignoring other teams that have had similarly easy starts this season, like the San Antonio Spurs.
 One fan simply wrote: "Keep that same energy with the Spurs!"
 Another fan added: "Anti-Luka Doncic propaganda is so ridiculous, even Twitter/X knows they're doing it to prop up Wembanyama."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement A third fan pointed Shelburne to the Eastern Conference: "76ers have played zero Western Conference teams, by the way."
 A fourth fan broke down the statistics to prove Shelburne wrong: "Lakers have beaten 7 teams with a record above .500. The Spurs have beaten 5 such teams. Ramona Shelburne, please do your research if you're going to get on ESPN and spread false narratives to undermine the Lakers. It's getting old."
 A fifth fan suggested this was always going to be the case with ESPN: "This was always the most predictable narrative switch."
 And one final fan suggested the ESPN veteran has a history of criticising the Lakers: "Shelburne is a LONG-TIME Laker hater! Nothing to see here!"
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The post on X went viral quickly, having amassed nearly 750,000 views with over 900 comments. In fact, one fan even contributed a Community Note to clarify why Shelburne was wrong with statistical evidence.
 Clearly, Shelburne's scepticism towards the Lakers is not shared by most fans, who believe she isn't acknowledging the reality of the situation.
